verdict.rationale: Brex documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants act on a Brex account in natural language: managing expenses, looking up users, checking cards, reviewing banking transactions and tracking bills. It also advertises an in-app AI-powered expense assistant. Community comments question the accuracy of an earlier Brex LLM bot demo, including one wrong answer about receipts, but this concerns output reliability rather than whether natural-language operation exists, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of supported commands and write actions, independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP or assistant working reliably, and detail on how the in-app assistant handles natural-language commands.
